headline: 5 types of bones by shape
stat_note: shapes: long, short, flat, irregular, sesamoid
body:
Long: femur, humerus, phalanges
Short: carpals + tarsals only
Flat: skull, scapula, sternum, ribs
Irregular: vertebrae, some facial bones
Sesamoid: patella (forms in a tendon)
source: Source: OpenStax Anatomy & Physiology, 6.2 Bone Classification

headline: Anatomical directional terms
stat_note: of opposite terms to learn first
body:
Anterior / posterior: front / back
Superior / inferior: above / below
Medial / lateral: to the midline / side
Proximal / distal: near / far from trunk
Superficial / deep: near / far from surface
source: Source: OpenStax Anatomy & Physiology, 1.6 Anatomical Terminology
